[EN] Once the seal came down, demons started pouring into the catacombs.

I don't know who's summoning them, but if we don't re-engage the seal soon, I don't think it's going to matter.
[ES] Una vez que el sello cayó, los demonios comenzaron a inundar las catacumbas.

No sé quién los está invocando, pero si no volvemos a activar el sello pronto, creo que ya no importará.
